$comment: VALE items (CONTRACT §4 ItemDef, §5.6 shop). Frames: starter/consumable/basic without components = Slate (1 tick); basic WITH components = Verdigris (2); core = Gloam (3); apex = Noonlit (4; the dial-slot rule: each stands at an hour, dial.hour, and two carried Noonlit items must stand dial.apart = 4 or more hours apart, so a fighter carries one to three; W4 re-key 2026-10-28). Starters carry foldsInto [core]: the first Gloam core bought while one is carried folds it in at full price; boots = Slate base, Verdigris upgrades. cost is the TOTAL price incl. components. Pools: rift = all but noon_tonic; bridge = no starters, no fray tonic; fray = Verdigris + boots + noon_tonic only (finished pieces, no wards, no Gloam/Noonlit). Build trees, class builds and calibration: _design/sections/items_setup.md. Validated by _harness/probe_items.ts. W4 G7 (2026-10-28): 31 finished pieces (20 Gloam, 11 Noonlit) priced about 20 % under the reference band; the Lampblack anti-heal pieces share uniqueGroup 'lampblack' (one per fighter); bots read item roles from this data (src/sim/bots/knowledge.ts itemRole). The 18 new pieces use a related item's icon as a placeholder until W2 paints assets/ui/icons/items/<id>.webp (handoff).
